SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 42.945338, -82.415605 (Approximated from premise)
Report Description\\ NEEC INCIDENT NOTIFICATION: PETROLEUM COKE RUN-OFF TO STORM DRAIN | VIP RAIL | ST. CLAIR RIVER | SARNIA, ON \\ THE CALLER IS REPORTING CONCERNS ABOUT HOW RAIL CARS ARE CLEANED. THE CALLER REPORTS THEY WORK FOR VIP RAIL/VITAL INDUSTRIAL PARK AND HAS TAKEN VIDEOS OF CLEANING PRACTICES AT THE FACILITY. THE CALLER WAS UNABLE TO RECALL THE DATE OF THE VIDEOS OR THE TIME OF CONCERN. THE CALLER REPORTS MANHOLES UNDER THE CARS ARE FILLED WITH PET COKE AND WASH AWAY DURING RAIN EVENTS. THE CALLER SAYS THE AREA FLOODED AND THIS WOULD HAVE SENT PET COKE INTO THE SURROUNDING ENVIRONMENT. THE CALLER REPORTS TO LOWER WATER LEVELS ON SITE DURING THE FLOOD, THE COMPANY PUMPED WATER WITH PET COKE IN IT TO AN ADJACENT FIELD AND DITCH. THE CALLER SAYS THE SURROUNDING SOIL IS CONTAMINATED FROM THESE PRACTICES AND SHOULD BE SAMPLED. THE CALLER REPORTS ALL OF THE STATIONS (CAR CLEANING STATION, 3-4 LOADING STATIONS) HAVE ISSUES WITH DIESEL AND SHEENING IS OBSERVED IN PUDDLES ON SITE WHEN IT RAINS. THE CALLER ALSO SAYS SOMETIMES THERE IS 4-5" OF PET COKE IN THE CARS WHEN THEY GO TO CLEAN THEM, WHICH SHOULD BE SENT BACK TO THE COMPANY BUT IS INSTEAD WASHED OUT ON SITE. THE CALLER REPORTS THE PET COKE BECOMES AIRBORNE. THE CALLER REPORTS THESE TRACKS ARE ON PRIVATE PROPERTY AND NOT PART OF THE FEDERAL RAIL SYSTEM.

IT APPEARS THAT THEY GAINED ACCESS TO BERTH 601 BY CLIMBING OVER SECURITY FENCE. AT 19:24 PORT OF PORTLAND MARINE SECURITY RECEIVED A CALL FROM AWC THAT THERE WERE THREE INDIVIDUALS INSIDE THEIR FENCE LINE OPERATING THREE DIFFERENT NEW VEHICLES THAT WERE PARKED AWAITING TRANSPORT. Location: 7765 UP RIVER ROAD
Incident Type: PIPELINE
Material: OIL: CRUDE
Suspected Responsible Party: PLAINS PIPELINE
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 27.821615, -97.516201 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 210 gallon
Report DescriptionCALLER IS REPORTING A DISCHARGE OF 5 BARRELS OF CRUDE OIL INTO SECONDARY CONTAINMENT AT THE INCIDENT LOCATION. THE DISCHARGE WAS DUE TO A LOW SUCTION LINE ON THE STORAGE TANK. CALLER STATED THIS SPILL WAS OBSERVED TODAY. HOWEVER, ON SATURDAY THE FACILITY LOGS INDICATE THAT A WORKER DID OPEN A VALVE TO DRAIN WATER OUT OF THE CONTAINMENT. CALLER STATED TODAY AROUND THE AREA WHERE THE WATER WAS DRAINED THEY OBSERVED DEAD VEGETATION AND A SMALL SHEEN ON SOME SURFACE WATER. THE COMPANY IS TRYING TO GET IN TOUCH WITH THE WORKER TO GET MORE DETAILS. CALLER IS MAKING NOTIFICATION DUE TO A POTENTIAL THREAT TO A NAVIGABLE WATER GIVEN THE FACILITY"S CLOSE PROXIMITY TO A WATERWAY, BUT NO IMPACT HAS BEEN OBSERVED AT THIS TIME. CALLER WANTED TO NOTE THIS WAS NOT A REPORTABLE INCIDENT FOR DOT, BUT REPORTING TO EPA FOR POTENTIAL NAVIGABLE WATERWAY IMPACT.
